motion.progress: 600ms width transition using actual admitted / target counts
motion.accessibility: All animation and transitions disabled for prefers-reduced-motion

preferredPrimitives: Existing TagInput, Notice, Spinner, LoadingStatus, Pager and Modal

must: Use existing Pluvus CSS tokens and native controls
Retain autosave, revision fencing, idempotency, exclusions and backend count limits
Keep search and navigation in the URL
avoid: Animation that delays actions or ignores reduced-motion preferences

decisions: Sourcing setup uses Criteria → Exclusions → Review & search, with editable steps and one primary action per step.
Archive is a separate library view; use labelled Archive and Restore actions with undo feedback.
Suggested criteria use semantic field icons and a Sparkles marker until edited.
Search results lead with actual considered, qualified, excluded and duplicate counters; criteria and activity expand below the progress overview.
Render API pictureUrl in creator tables, detail drawers and exclusion previews with initials for missing or failed images.
Use layout-preserving skeletons for page and data loading, spinners for pending actions, and short reduced-motion-aware feedback transitions.
All async components use visible action-specific loading feedback; retain saved rows during refresh, disable export while selection saves, and keep focus and inputs stable while dialogs submit.
